question: Can the physics apparatus return the correct verdict on constructed calibration banks whose ground truth is known by construction? Concretely: (a) a regime-independent bank matched in marginals must return p_bonf > 0.10 and |BC| < 0.05; (b) a bank where a regime is injected through a channel that is NOT a copy of the latent state must return p_bonf < 0.01, BC > 0.05, and gap >= 0.05 over the regime-independent null. Only if BOTH banks return the correct verdict is the instrument considered calibrated for any later Web-dynamics question.
hypothesis: H1 (instrument calibration): The corrected apparatus — using a representation-dependent analytic null E[PMI] = sum_c p(c)[digamma(K*alpha) - digamma(N_c + K*alpha) + sum_i(digamma(n_i + alpha) - digamma(alpha))]/ln(2) with K = n_states_observed and alpha = 1/K per stratum, together with a non-negative entropy estimator (exact Dirichlet-Multinomial plug-in) whose two entropies share one state-space support — will produce opposite, correct verdicts on the two calibration banks: the regime-independent null bank returns p_bonf > 0.10 and |BC| < 0.05; the non-copy regime-injected positive bank returns p_bonf < 0.01, BC > 0.05, and gap >= 0.05. H0: At least one bank returns the wrong verdict (null bank p_bonf <= 0.10 or |BC| >= 0.05, or positive bank p_bonf >= 0.01 or BC <= 0.05 or gap < 0.05). In that case the C-WEB-DYNAMICS measurement paradigm is not instrumented and the thread is retired.
falsifier: The regime-independent calibration bank (constructed to have zero regime-dependent structure by design, with matched marginals across regimes) returns p_bonf <= 0.10 or |BC| >= 0.05; OR the non-copy regime-injected calibration bank (constructed with a regime signal injected through a channel that is provably not a deterministic function of the latent state) returns p_bonf >= 0.01 or BC <= 0.05 or gap < 0.05. Either failure means the instrument cannot reliably distinguish signal from null on known-ground-truth banks, and no later Web-dynamics claim from this paradigm is interpretable.

B-INDEPENDENT-REGIME-NULL.description: Regime-independent bank: next_state depends only on (cur_state, action); regime label is assigned independently of the transition kernel and the observable R is generated from cur_state + action only (no regime information). Marginal P(S_next|C) is identical across regimes by construction.

B-IID-MARGINAL-NULL.description: IID resampled S_next from the marginal P(S_next) of the correlated bank, destroying all conditional structure. Standard i.i.d. null.

B-HISTORY-MARKOV.description: Order-3 history-only baseline P(S_next | C, A) without DOM representation R. Measures how much predictive power is in history alone.
B-HISTORY-MARKOV.expected: BC_history ~ 0, gap to primary > 0.05 if regime signal is beyond-history

positive_control.description: Non-copy regime-injected bank: next_state depends on (cur_state, action, regime) where regime is a latent variable. The observable R is generated from a channel that correlates with regime but is NOT a deterministic copy of the latent state index. Specifically: R = f(cur_state, action, regime) + noise, where the regime-dependence is through a stochastic mixing channel that preserves MI(R; regime) > 0.3 but MI(R; latent_state_index) is bounded away from 1.0.
positive_control.expected: p_bonf < 0.01, BC > 0.05, gap over B-INDEPENDENT-REGIME-NULL >= 0.05, MI(R; regime) > 0.3, MI(R; latent_state) < 0.9

null_control.description: Regime-independent bank matched in marginals: identical P(S_next|C,A) across regimes, identical P(R|C,A) across regimes, regime label is independent noise. This is the primary null control for the calibration gate.

measurement_validity: No browser, no CDP, no Playwright, no network calls — purely in-process synthetic banks with known generative structure

Representation-dependent analytic null: E[PMI] = sum_c p(c)[digamma(K*alpha) - digamma(N_c + K*alpha) + sum_i(digamma(n_i + alpha) - gammaln(alpha))]/ln(2) with K = n_states_observed (not fixed K_HIST=3), alpha = 1/K per stratum, computed via gammaln/polygamma without heuristic scaling, divisors, or clamping

Non-negative entropy estimator: exact Dirichlet-Multinomial plug-in for H(S_next|C) and H(S_next|C,R) with shared state-space support K = n_states_observed. The difference H(S_next|C) - H(S_next|C,R) is guaranteed >= 0 by construction (both entropies over same support with same alpha)
K = n_states_observed (count of unique S_next in the bank), not a fixed historical constant. Alpha = 1/K per stratum.
Permutation test: 1000 trajectory-grouped shuffles within each C stratum, seed 42, PYTHONHASHSEED=0. p_bonf = min(1.0, p_raw * n_effective_tests) with floor 0.001
TRAIN/TEST split: 70/30 by trajectory_id, all fitting (strata, vocabularies, K, alpha) on TRAIN only
Collinearity check: effective_n_tests = number of representation channels with pairwise BC correlation < 0.95; disclosed and used for Bonferroni

Analytic centering gate G0: |perm_mean - analytic_mean| < 0.03 AND |analytic_mean| < 0.1 for each primary R on BOTH calibration banks. If G0 fails on either bank, the experiment is MEASUREMENT_INVALID

decision_rule.gate_G0_analytic_centering: |perm_mean - analytic_mean| < 0.03 and |analytic_mean| < 0.1 for each R on BOTH banks (REQUIRED for validity)
decision_rule.gate_G2_positive_bank: CTRL_POS_NONCOPY_REGIME: p_bonf < 0.01 AND BC > 0.05 AND (BC_positive - BC_null) >= 0.05 (REQUIRED)
decision_rule.gate_G3_identifiability: CTRL_POS_NONCOPY_REGIME: MI(R; regime) > 0.3 AND MI(R; latent_state_index) < 0.9 (confirms non-copy channel)

verdict.CALIBRATED: All gates G0, G1, G2, G3 PASS on both banks -> status=COMPLETE, outcome=SUPPORTS. Instrument is calibrated; a later packet may ask the non-Markovian relaxation-time question.
verdict.NOT_INSTRUMENTED: Any gate fails on either bank -> status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome=NOT_APPLICABLE. C-WEB-DYNAMICS measurement paradigm is not instrumented; thread is retired per Director mandate. No further pointwise conditional-PMI sweeps on synthetic FSM facade.

product_consequence_positive: Instrument calibration established. The physics apparatus can reliably distinguish a known null from a known positive on constructed banks. This enables a subsequent experiment (requiring Runtime substrate) to test whether H(S_{t+k} | S_t, URL_t, regime-history) decays more slowly than a matched order-(k-1) Markov null for k >= 2 on a locally served SPA with server-side ground-truth transition log (non-Markovian / relaxation-time signature). C-WEB-DYNAMICS remains HYPOTHESIS but the measurement pathway is now valid.
product_consequence_negative: Instrument calibration failed. The C-WEB-DYNAMICS measurement paradigm (pointwise conditional PMI on synthetic FSM facade with current estimator/analytic/null design) cannot return correct verdicts on known ground truth. The thread is RETIRED rather than repaired a ninth time. No further Physics cycles on this paradigm. C-WEB-DYNAMICS remains HYPOTHESIS in the registry but the predictive-accuracy/pointwise-PMI detection method is rejected as a valid instrument. Future Physics work on C-WEB-DYNAMICS must pursue orthogonal detection methods (effect factorization, barriers, timescales, geometry, multiscale dynamics, or other measurable mechanisms per registry next_gate).
expected_information_gain: Binary, high-stakes instrument verdict. A PASS converts 80 invalid experiments into a validated instrument and unlocks the non-Markovian question. A FAIL honestly retires a paradigm that has consumed 80 experiments with zero valid positives, freeing capacity for orthogonal Physics programs. Either outcome is decisive and changes the program trajectory.
